links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of AI versus pediatric ophthalmologists and existing AI methods on same data
links.effect: AI achieved binary accuracy 96.8% (AUC 0.992) and multi-class accuracy 92.5% (AUC 0.983), with agreement with gold standard κ = 0.931; comparable to specialist evaluation.
links.quote: The diagnostic performance was compared against pediatric ophthalmologists and existing AI methods.

unlisted_practices: Integrated real-time gaze-tracking feedback module for vergence and anti-suppression therapy
Multimodal fusion of eye-tracking and image data versus unimodal baselines (ablation)

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic accuracy and therapeutic trial evaluating a dual-stream deep learning gaze tracking system in 250 pediatric patients, reporting accuracy, therapeutic impact, and workflow efficiency.
